message:
As parents, we often find ourselves trying to prepare our kids for life’s little surprises, but what about preparing together for unexpected events? 🏡 

It can be a great bonding experience to explore our family’s emergency plan as a team. Kids can learn valuable skills, and we might even discover their unique ideas about safety along the way! 

Let’s embrace this chance to turn preparedness into a family project that strengthens our connections and keeps us all feeling secure. What’s one thing you’d like to include in your family’s plan?
